services.title: Four ways we help your business

assistants.title: AI assistants
assistants.body: AI that works behind the computer to help with management, operations and marketing, without hiring more staff.

strategy.title: AI training for business
strategy.body: Invite us to teach you and your staff to use AI for your business, such as writing promotions, preparing quotes and summarising reports. At your place or online.

content.title: Photos & videos with AI
content.body: We make product photos, ad videos, creator-style review videos and even brand character animations, all with AI, for your content and promotions.

training.title: Skills classes for the AI era
training.body: Learn to raise the quality of your work with AI and sharpen the skills AI can't replace, such as communication and strategy. For students through to working professionals.

useCase.title: Which parts of your business can AI help with?
useCase.intro: Work that usually needs extra staff, or that takes up your staff's time today. Pick a part of the business.
useCase.note: Don't see your work here? Tell us about it.

uses.label: Post ideas
uses.text: Every week you get a list of post ideas from what's trending in your field.

uses.label: Post drafts
uses.text: Send one topic, and a draft post is prepared in your business's style, ready for your approval.

uses.label: Prospects
uses.text: Prospects who have asked before are noted down, and you're reminded when to get back to them.

uses.label: Past customers
uses.text: Promo news goes out to past customers, so they remember to shop again.

uses.label: Customer questions
uses.text: Questions about prices, stock and services are answered automatically, including at night.

uses.label: Orders
uses.text: Orders that come in by chat are recorded on their own, with no retyping.

uses.label: Bookings
uses.text: Customers pick a free slot right in the chat and it's recorded automatically, without waiting for you to reply and check the schedule.

uses.label: Stock
uses.text: You're reminded before items run out, so there's still time to restock.

uses.label: Invoices
uses.text: Customers who haven't paid get a polite reminder, so you don't have to feel awkward chasing them yourself.

uses.label: Payment proof
uses.text: Transfer receipts from customers are checked, then the order is marked as paid.

uses.label: Expenses
uses.text: Just send a message like “bought gas, 25k” and the expense is recorded right away.

uses.label: Receipts & files
uses.text: Photos of receipts and documents sent by chat are filed neatly per customer.

uses.label: Daily recap
uses.text: Today's total sales and best sellers reach your phone every evening.

uses.label: Complaints
uses.text: Customer complaints from different chats are gathered in one place, so you know what people complain about most.

uses.label: New staff
uses.text: New staff ask how the shop works, and the assistant answers from the rules you wrote.

uses.label: Weekly summary
uses.text: Every week you get a summary of the busiest days and the items that rarely sell.

faq.title: What business owners often ask
faq.help: Still have questions? Ask us directly.

items.q: If I use AI, do I have to let my staff go?
items.a: No need. AI takes over the admin tasks, then we train your staff to sell, negotiate and plan strategy. The decision stays in your hands.

items.q: What if the AI gives a wrong answer?
items.a: The assistant only answers from information you approve, such as your price list and opening hours. When it's unsure, the chat is passed on to you or your staff. Before it goes live, the assistant is tested with your customers' questions.

items.q: I'm not good with technology. Can I still use it?
items.a: Yes. You just tell us about the work. We set it up, test it and teach you to use the assistant until you're comfortable, for free.

items.q: I don't have any staff yet. Can I start with AI right away?
items.a: Yes. The AI assistant does the admin tasks that are usually the reason to hire, so you can grow without taking on a fixed salary straight away.

items.q: Do I have to change my number or app?
items.a: No. The assistant connects to the number your customers already know, and we take care of the verification.

It depends on the work you want help with, because every business is different. After the free consultation you get a clear quote, and you can compare it with the cost of hiring one person for the same work.
Data is only used to run your assistant. Access is restricted, and the data stays yours.
Yes. We're based in Pekanbaru and happy to visit your business.
